TYPE Manrope Regular 14/18 ls-4pct #FFFFFF = lg:text-[14px] lg:leading-[18px] font-normal tracking-[-0.04em]. ★ CROSS-CHECK: these are the identical panel values SocialMenu.tsx already ships for this section's other dropdown-* frames (rounded-[12px] border-green-coal-100 bg-green-coal-200 p-2 gap-2 and the same 0/4/12/0.24 shadow), which is independent evidence that this is ONE panel and not a lookalike. ★ THE ROW LIST WAS WRONG, not just the chrome. All three frames hold FOUR rows - Frame 228 'Chat settings' first, a 1px #123F3C hairline, then 'Stream viewers', 'Hide chat menu', 'Pop out chat'. ★ AND A CORRECTION I MADE TO MY OWN FIRST READING: Frame 228 is the only row carrying a fill (#123F3C), which reads as 'Chat settings is active'. It is not. The sibling dropdown-balances frames 9640-213620 / 11530-303185 / 11530-303236 fill their FIRST row too, and that row is 'View on Skai wallet' - an action, not a state anything can be on. So the fill is the FOCUS WASH on row 0, which is also what SocialMenu.tsx concluded in its own words ('the wash follows the user, not a fixed row'). Hardcoding it would have shipped a permanently-active-looking row that is merely first; it ships as hover/focus/data-[highlighted] instead. The component shipped three: 'Live chat', 'Stream viewers', 'Pop out chat'. 'Live chat' is absent from the frame because the frame is the menu opened FROM the chat panel, so the row for the panel you are on is not drawn - it is KEPT (WAVE5 section 6) because it is what makes the control work from the viewers side. 'Chat settings' and 'Hide chat menu' were genuinely MISSING and are now added under onPopOutChat's rule: the row renders only when a handler is supplied. Streaming.tsx already owns setChatSettingsOpen so Chat settings is live; NOTHING supplies onHideChat, so that row does not render and the frames stay partial for it. REMAINS: the four traced 16x16 vectors are matched by SHAPE to lucide equivalents, not glyph-for-glyph.
